leah (Product): Heads-up: Brightline asks for an APAC pilot with BYOK + per-tenant opt-in. They want an A/B against our standard hosted model and a staged canary that prioritizes Tokyo -> Sydney -> Singapore. Legal also wants retention proof. Need scoping.

omar (Eng): BYOK + region-specific routing is doable but we need an opt-in flag + routing map. Hosted BYOK requires envelope encryption support and audit logs for key usage (who used which key when).

tess (SRE): For APAC routing we should do a controlled canary: 0.1% shadow for 48h -> 5% opt-in cohort -> 25% A/B slice -> 100%. Mirror traffic to APAC in shadow mode only to validate model parity. If mirror queue exceeds threshold, drop mirrors and alert.

vik (Solutions): Brightline's ask: admin toggles for each stage, explicit kill-switch that they can trigger, exportable daily audit with nonce + key IDs, and an A/B dashboard showing CTR/latency deltas. They also asked for a 30-day evidence of deletion if key is revoked.

harry (Legal): We need the deletion window in contract. Also confirm whether our audit logs expose key IDs or only hashed refs. Hashing is preferred. We must avoid storing customer plaintext keys.

omar (Eng): Draft flag config: 

```
flag: brightline_apac_byok_v1
cohorts: [shadow_0_1pct, optin_5pct, ab_25pct]
route_header: x-region-preference
mirror_header: x-mirror-apac
kms_mode: envelope-byok
audit_mode: key-hash + event-id
kill_switch: /ops/flags/brightline_apac_byok_v1/disable
```

tess (SRE): Operational rules: mirror queue max 2000 msgs, mirror throttle 10rps, p95 latency guard 120ms threshold -> auto-failover to global-hosted and disable mirror. Add synthetic canary every 5m for Tokyo region.

leah (Product): Brightline timeline: pilot must start in 5 weeks. We need decision: a) force Dedicated/Private to simplify KMS + audit, or b) support hosted BYOK with extra dev. Pros/cons?

vik (Solutions): They prefer hosted BYOK to avoid procurement delays. If we can provide envelope BYOK + hashed audit logs + deletion proof, procurement says green.

omar (Eng): Estimates: BYOK envelope & audit hashing = 2.5w, mirror + throttles + auto-fail = 2w, rollout UI + per-tenant toggles = 1w, A/B telemetry plumbing = 1w. Total ~6.5w if serial; parallel could be ~4w with 2 teams. Need SRE for throttles.

harry (Legal): For deletion proof, we can provide audit showing key revocation event + that data encrypted under revoked key was re-encrypted or inaccessible. Ops must document the rotation/re-encryption step.

leah (Product): Risk register (quick): 1) Mirror-induced latency -> mitigation: throttle + synthetic canaries + auto-fail. 2) BYOK leakage concerns -> mitigation: only store key metadata hashes, never plaintext. 3) Billing/limits -> mitigation: reserve token capacity in APAC for pilot.

tess (SRE): Preflight: run 48h shadow at 0.1% using mirror header in staging, collect latencies and error budget. If p95 increase <10% and error rate <0.5% we proceed to opt-in.

omar (Eng): Can we add an experiment tag for correlation with customer metrics? e.g. x-experiment: brightline_apac_ab2025. We'll salt and hash user ids before exporting.

vik (Solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing runbook: how to opt-in tenants, how to trigger kill-switch, what metrics we'll share, and schedule for daily A/B reports. Aim to share tomorrow.

leah (Product): Decisions: go hosted-BYOK gated by: envelope BYOK + audit hashing + throttled mirror + capacity reservation + signed pilot SOW. If we can't deliver BYOK in 3w, fall back to Dedicated pilot.

deploy-bot: Reminder: add rollback playbook link to the release job: /ops/playbooks/rollback-byok-pilot.md :robot_face:

vik (Solutions): Brightline also requested a CLI snippet to opt-in tenants. Proposed curl: 

```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"brightline-123","flag":"brightline_apac_byok_v1","cohort":"optin_5pct"}' \ 
  https://console.redwood.ai/internal/flags/optin
```

tess (SRE): I'll own the mirror throttle + synthetic canaries. @omar please handoff the mirror endpoint spec.

omar (Eng): Will do. I'll put up a PR with config schema and a small staging test harness.

leah (Product): Action items: @omar implement BYOK envelope + staged mirror (2.5w), @tess implement throttles + canaries (2w), @vik draft runbook and customer CLI (this week), @harry finalize contract language for deletion proof. I'll update the roadmap and mark as "customer-driven pilot".

vik (Solutions): Noted. Sharing runbook draft by EOD.

leah (Product): Great work. We'll reconvene next Tue to review staging shadow results before moving to opt-in. :thumbsup:
